rows.en: We can even create Innovators as we please...
...beings with the power to transform the world, surpassing even Super Soldiers and Newtypes!
Well then! It'd be a waste to leave all the fun to Regnant.
Heh... That was easier than I expected. I'll be more than happy to finish you off myself, okay?
We won't let you do as you please any longer!!
I've come to repay the favor!!
If you thought it'd only be Gundams, you're dead wrong!?
...Damn it!! Regnant!! Crush them all at once!!
Hiding happens to be my specialty!!
No matter how many of you vermin gang up...!!
Hold it!! Garazzo!! The odds really are against us now.
Tch... Fine, whatever. But you'd better assume your base is already gone.
Ohh, too bad for you!! We already wrecked that particle cannon, y'know?
Heh, you think that was our only giant weapon?
Hahahaha!!! Didn't you know? Memento Mori, the Barge Cannon, the Libra Cannon, and...
Hahaha, there are so many it's hard to keep track of them all.
If even one of them fires, there won't be a trace of your base left, you know?
Hm...? The Libra Cannon...? Is that true!!
...Heh heh heh heh. Hey, you lot? Speak of the devil, as they say.
The Libra Cannon has just fired!!
What did you say!! What about the base...!!
"...We took a direct hit. ...The Capture Cube shielded us somewhat, but..."
"If we take another direct hit, it really will be the end."
That was a Libra Cannon test shot. 30% power. Heh heh heh heh... You got lucky, didn't you?
But that wraps up the final adjustments. I'm looking forward to the next shot! Hahahaha...!!
Damn... We'd better assume the other giant weapons can fire too, not just the Libra Cannon.
Yeah. We can't just sit around...!!

notes.note: 0629.bla gives this line CHARA_NAME.3 (Den-O label), the same id the tracer shows for leader blocks; may actually be the party leader. Wording is speaker-neutral.
0.118-119 one sentence split across rows; Gadessa (Revive) explaining Ribbons made Regnant an Innovator. 'Super Soldiers' per glossary.

Leader block 0.124-138 (TextIdOffset+123+k). First Pt_Chara_Check chain in 0629.bla: 10,6,9,8,7,1,2,4,5,11,12,13,15,14,3 = 00, Nu, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Rider 1, RX, W, OOO, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Zero, Mebius, Den-O. Fits the wording: Ultras 0.133-137 share the katakana scream, 0.138 'nuaaa' = Momotaros. Same chain checks out against story_117 blocks (0.94/0.114 rough = Momotaros, 0.92 'chii' = Zero). Different JP spellings kept as slightly different screams; identical JP -> identical EN.
Gaddess (Hiling) launches her GN Fangs; 0.141 (offset+140) is absent from the table.
Sandrock (Quatre): subject 'we' restored for the arriving group.

Arios: 'kari wo kaeshi ni kita' read as repaying the favour to the heroes (friendly yo-ending; he stayed behind for them in 0603). Could also mean getting even with the Innovators. Subject 'I' restored.

Leader block 0.149-163 (separate MessWinSet calls offset+148..162); extractor labels them all Den-O Sword Form. Assumed the same first chain (00, Nu, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Rider 1, RX, W, OOO, Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Zero, Mebius, Den-O): W 'tasukaru ze', OOO 'tasukarimasu', Mebius 'minna' fit. Uncertain: 0.155 rough 'omee-ra' lands on RX and 0.163 'sumanai' on Den-O; English kept voice-neutral so either mapping works.
Garazzo counts them with the animal counter; rendered 'you vermin'.
No speaker; offset+172 is NOT called by 0629.bla (script goes from Garazzo +171 to Duo +173), so this row is likely unused. Translated as Duo's laugh, which leads into 0.174.
Superweapons: Memento Mori (00), Barge Cannon (Wing; official English 'Barge'), Libra Cannon (Wing), Colony Laser (glossary). Only Colony Laser is in the glossary.
Gadessa (Revive) receiving a brainwave message from Ribbons (polite desu-ka); the verb after 'Libra Cannon' is omitted in the source and kept omitted - the next rows reveal it was fired.
'Uwasa wo sureba nantoyara' = speak of the devil.
Comm beeps and Zoffy's transmission in double quotes, following the announcement precedent for these brackets.
Speaker CHARA_NAME.128 = Zoffy at the base. 'We' restored.

0.199-213 block uses a NEW chain right before it: 10,9,6,7,4,5,3,15,14,8,13,12,11,2,1 = 00, Wing Zero, Nu, Zeta, W, OOO, Den-O, Zero, Mebius, God, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, RX, Rider 1 (confirmed by 0.205 Momotaros 'terminal-whatsit', 0.207 polite Mebius in story_119). 0.199-202 = 00, Wing Zero, Nu, Zeta; identical JP -> identical EN.

report: 80/80 rows. Uncertain: 0.155/0.163 voice in leader block 0.149-163 (order assumed from first chain; English kept neutral); 0.173 unused line, speaker assumed Duo; 0.147 'repay the favor' direction; 0.117 speaker label Den-O may be the leader. Not in glossary: Memento Mori, Barge Cannon, Libra Cannon; Capture Cube and Terminal Unit follow precedent.
